claim: Fixed-image/fixed-noise state sensitivity check. State-off is an empirically inert channel; state-on is the discrete state-token path. This is an input diagnostic, not a task result.

on.decoded_prefix_frame0: Task: Sort the red cubes into the red tray and the blue cubes into the blue tray., State: 91 -1 221 -1 91 255 120 -1 232 -1 120 255; Action:

interpretation: With images, task and flow noise fixed, changing only the 12-D state leaves the state-off tokens and actions bit-identical, while the state-on mode changes 43 token positions and produces a 5.15 deg maximum action difference. The E3 checkpoint is therefore state-blind; a tokenizer/mask fault does not explain that result. State-on tokens are a valid, untruncated prefix and encode the quantized state as text. Training and serving used the same saved run_config state_mode and config SHA, rather than an inference-only switch.
